name: hovercard3
title: Profile Hover Card
description: A tall portrait card shows a man's photo with his name and role along the bottom; hovering swaps the image for a flat red-orange bio panel with a short paragraph and Learn More button.
use: An about or team page wants compact people cards that give a short bio on hover.
avoid: Touch and keyboard users never trigger the bio, since the reveal is hover-only on a plain div.
a11y: Bio and button sit behind a hover-only overlay on a non-focusable div, so keyboard users cannot reach them; alt text says 'shoes' for a portrait. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rectangular card holds a portrait of a smiling man against a plain grey studio wall. A red-orange band at the bottom carries his name in bold white and 'CEO & Design Engineer' beneath it.
behaves: Hovering fades the photo out beneath a solid red-orange panel that slides its content up, swapping name and role for a 'Who we are' heading, a short paragraph and a black Learn More button; leaving restores the portrait.
customise: The photo, name, role, bio paragraph and button are hardcoded, as are the red-orange palette and 400x450 size; all changes need a source edit.
weight: light: One photo and CSS opacity transitions on two overlay panels.
